description: This Java source file implements the MessageSourceService interface for the OpenMRS platform, managing message sources such as localization messages. It provides methods to retrieve messages, manage message sources, and handle message presentations within the application.

classes.name: MessageSourceServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the MessageSourceService interface, managing multiple message sources and providing message retrieval and management functions.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message string by its code, defaulting to context locale.

methods.name: getActiveMessageSource
methods.description: Returns the currently active message source used by the service.

methods.name: setActiveMessageSource
methods.description: Sets the currently active message source and adds it to available sources.

methods.name: getLocales
methods.description: Returns available locales from the active message source.

methods.name: getPresentations
methods.description: Returns all message presentations from the active message source.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message based on a MessageSourceResolvable.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message string with given code, arguments, and locale.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a message string with fallback default message.

methods.name: addPresentation
methods.description: Adds a message presentation to the active message source.

methods.name: removePresentation
methods.description: Removes a message presentation from the active message source.

methods.name: getMessageSources
methods.description: Returns the set of all available message sources.

methods.name: setMessageSources
methods.description: Adds provided message sources to the available set.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges messages from another source into the active message source.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific message presentation by key and locale.

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale
methods.description: Returns all message presentations in a specified locale.
